content.title: Inside Kimi Antonelli’s Life: F1 Salary, Net Worth, Girlfriend, And Career of Mercedes’ 19-Year-Old Formula 1 Sensation
content.text: Formula 1 has always seen young talent rise from the grassroots, but only a few manage to grab the spotlight right at the start of their careers. One of them is 19-year-old Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli, who won the 2026 Chinese Grand Prix and became the second-youngest race winner in F1 history, behind only Max Verstappen, who won his first race at the age of 18. But who exactly is Kimi Antonelli? What is his F1 2026 salary, how did he rise through the ranks to world’s most thrilling motorsports, and what do we know about his life off the track? Here’s everything you need to know.The young Italian created history on Saturday by becoming the youngest pole sitter in Formula 1 history after qualifying first in Shanghai, ahead of his teammate George Russell. On race day, Antonelli did not make a mistak, leading the field that incuded seven-time world champion Lewis Hamilton, four-time world champion Max Verstappen, and other star drivers.Hamilton finished third, while Russell held on to second place, giving Mercedes another 1-2 finish early in the 2026 season. The result followed the team’s strong start at the season opener, the Australian Grand Prix, where Antonelli had already finished second.For Antonelli, it was the first Formula 1 victory of his career, a moment every driver dreams about. And when the reality finally hit him after the race, the young Italian struggled to hide his emotions.“I’m speechless,” Antonelli said in the post-race interview. “I’m about to cry, to be honest. Thank you so much to the team because they helped me achieve this dream.”
